provenance.paper_title: MoMuSE: Momentum Multi-modal Target Speaker Extraction for Real-time Scenarios with Impaired Visual Cues

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Speaker-identity momentum tracks the target when visual cues disappear.
A fixed learned momentum update refreshes speaker state. For MoMuSE, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of audio-visual speaker identity state.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (audio-visual speaker identity state) changes through a trained but frozen update module; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
